doc.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Never getting into drugs
summary: He took cocaine twice and never wanted it.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: How did you manage to not get involved in the drug scene?

I don’t know. Just… Oh, I think I took cocaine literally twice, and each time it had to do with, I was drunk and I had to get on the bandstand or something, but it just… I don’t know. It just never, never really appealed to me at all.
It’s not that you saw somebody you admired ruin themselves with it or, I mean, was there…?
Was there maybe somebody you saw that you admired musically, who you saw destroy themselves with it? I mean, were there just good reasons not to in your mind? Were you just too smart?

Oh, I’m smart. (laughs) I don’t, I don’t really know. It seemed like a… it seemed illegal to begin with. And… Although especially since I’ve been in the hospital all this time, my energy level is really low, and I have a prescription for something called Provigil, but even there, I have to be careful that I don’t overuse that so… The cigarette thing, I never, I never got at all. I just… anyhow… Yeah, I liked that that I put in the contract no smoking in any of these places. (laughs) I told you I did that in Germany not too long ago. Did I mention that? I was over there with…
